# Owner Deletion & Creation — Spring PetClinic REST (OfficeFloor)

## Key finding up front

The current DELETE implementation is a **hard delete**, but the acceptance tests expect a **soft delete** with a `deleted` flag. There is **no `deleted` field anywhere** — not in the `Owner` entity, not in any DB `schema.sql`, and `grep -rni "deleted"` over `src/main` returns nothing. So the tests in `AcceptanceTest.java` (which read back `$.deleted`) cannot pass against the current code. This is the gap between "how it works now" and "how the tests want it to work."

---

## 1. Owner entity and base classes

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`**
`@Entity @Table(name = "owners")`, extends `Person`. Fields (all `@Column`):
- `title`, `address` (`@NotEmpty`), `addressLine1`, `addressLine2`, `city` (`@NotEmpty`), `telephone` (`@NotEmpty`, `@Pattern` E.164 `^\+[0-9]{8,15}$`), `email`, `postcode`, `registrationDate` (LocalDate), `birthDate` (LocalDate), `customerCode`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount` (Integer), `householdSize` (Integer), `bulkSignupWarning` (Boolean), `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean), `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer).
- `@OneToMany(cascade = ALL, mappedBy = "owner", fetch = EAGER) Set<Pet> pets` plus pet helper methods (`getPets`, `addPet`, `getPet`).
- **No `deleted` field.**

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`**
`@MappedSuperclass`, extends `BaseEntity`. Fields: `firstName` (`@NotEmpty`), `lastName` (`@NotEmpty`).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/BaseEntity.java`**
`@MappedSuperclass`. Field: `id` (`Integer`, `@Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = IDENTITY)`). Methods `getId/setId`, and `@JsonIgnore boolean isNew()` = `id == null`.

---

## 2. Owner OfficeFloor YAML files

Under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/`:
- `owners.GET.yml`
- `owners.POST.yml` (create)
- `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml`
- `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`
- `owners/{ownerId}.DELETE.yml` (delete)
- `v2/owners.GET.yml`

Related escalations under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/`:
- `...OwnerDailyLimitExceededException.yml`, `...OwnerIdentityConflictException.yml`, `...OwnerFieldsInvalidException.yml`, `...OwnerCityAtCapacityException.yml`

### DELETE — `owners/{ownerId}.DELETE.yml`
`authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. Flow: `load` → `delete` → `respond`.
- load → `owner.LoadOwner`
- delete → `owner.DeleteOwner`
- respond → `common.RespondWithNoContent`

### POST (create) — `owners.POST.yml`
`authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. Linear chain (all `govern: [transaction]`):
`validate (ValidateOwnerFields)` → `checkCityCapacity (CheckOwnerCityCapacity)` → `checkDailyLimit (CheckOwnerDailyLimit)` → `build (BuildOwner)` → `assignHousehold (AssignHousehold)` → `checkIdentity (CheckOwnerIdentityUnique)` → `assignHouseholdSize` → `assignCustomerCode` → `assignNamesakeCount` → `assignBulkSignupWarning` → `assignPossibleDuplicate (AssignPossibleDuplicate)` → `save (SaveOwner)` → `audit (AuditOwnerCreated)` → `respond (RespondWithOwnerCreated)`.

The YAML comments explicitly describe household duplicate detection (409) and soft-match flagging, all running **before save** — but none of them consult a `deleted` flag.

---

## 3. Function classes (full source shown for the load-bearing ones)

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/` (except `RespondWithNoContent` under `.../function/common/`).

**`DeleteOwner.java`** — hard delete:
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
    ownerRepository.delete(owner);
}
```

**`LoadOwner.java`** — loads by path var `ownerId` via `ownerRepository.findById`, throws `NotFoundException` if absent (`Lookups.findOrNotFound`).

**`RespondWithNoContent.java`** (common) — sends `ResponseEntity.noContent().build()`.

**`BuildOwner.java`** — maps `OwnerFieldsDto` → `Owner` via `OwnerMapper`, defaults `registrationDate` to today, rolls it onto a business day (`BusinessDay.adjust`).

**`SaveOwner.java`** — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.

**`AssignHousehold.java`** — sets `householdId` = first 12 lowercase hex of `SHA-256(normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode)`. Deterministic; same lastName+postcode ⇒ same household.

**`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`** (identity/duplicate hard-check) — if `request.getSharesHousehold()` is true, bypass; else iterate `ownerRepository.findAll()` and throw `OwnerIdentityConflictException(householdId)` if any existing owner has the same `householdId`. **Iterates all owners with no `deleted`/soft-delete filter** — so a soft-deleted owner would still block re-creation, which is exactly what test `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck` says must not happen.

**`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** (soft-match flag) — if `sharesHousehold`, clears flags; else scans `ownerRepository.findAll()` for an existing owner with same postcode + case-insensitive lastName + different telephone, sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` (lowest matching id). Also **no `deleted` filter.**

**`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** — maps to `OwnerDto`, returns `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`**

- `Collection<Owner> findByLastName(String)` and `Page<Owner> findByLastName(String, Pageable)`
- `Owner findById(int)`
- `void save(Owner)`
- `Collection<Owner> findAll()` and `Page<Owner> findAll(Pageable)`
- `void delete(Owner)` — physical delete contract

No query method filters on any `deleted` flag.

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri

          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string

          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array

            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title

        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional. When present it drives the
            derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility, and also returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. The householdId is derived deterministically from the
            owner's last name and postcode, so owners sharing both are the same
            household. When true, the create request is admitted as a declared member
            of that household (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate); otherwise
            a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the owner's own fields: the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName when a title is present
                (e.g. 'DR who'), otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure over 365 days. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the customerCode (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId are empty
                when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one softly matches (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
